correctness.rationale: The unique inscribed ellipsoid inherits all horizontal rotations, and exact support-function optimization reduces containment to b<=c<=1-b and (1-t)c+sqrt(a^2+(1-t)^2 b^2)<=1. The objective has a unique maximum at b=min(1/2,1/((d+1)(1-t))) with the limit t=1 explicit. The derivative sign and pair-weighted argument prove the exact switch and strict fractional occupancy monotonicity in every dimension; standalone exact grid checks supplement rather than replace these analytical steps.
